article.linkText: NC State hosts Louisville in ACC matchup
article.story: Louisville (2-2) at NC State (2-2), Oct. 3 at 3:30 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Louisville by 6. Against the spread: Louisville 3-1, NC State 1-3. How to watch: ACC Network Key stats Louisville Offense Overall: 486.3 yards per game (18th in FBS) Passing: 295.8 yards per game (21st) Rushing: 190.5 yards per game (38th) Scoring: 41.3 points per game (18th) Louisville Defense Overall: 405.5 yards per game (116th in FBS) Passing: 240.3 yards per game (110th) Rushing: 165.3 yards per game (103rd) Scoring: 28.8 points per game (109th) NC State Offense Overall: 451.8 yards per game (34th in FBS) Passing: 232.8 yards per game (68th) Rushing: 219 yards per game (25th) Scoring: 38.3 points per game (31st) NC State Defense Overall: 327.8 yards per game (58th in FBS) Passing: 206.3 yards per game (69th) Rushing: 121.5 yards per game (58th) Scoring: 25 points per game (88th) NC State ranks 18th in FBS in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert on 28.3% of third downs. NC State ranks 80th in the FBS with a -1 turnover margin, compared to Louisville's 9th-ranked +6 margin. Louisville is 135th in the FBS averaging 93 penalty yards per game, compared to NC State's 33rd-ranked 48 per-game average. NC State is 97th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 90% of trips. Louisville's red zone offense ranks 30th, scoring on 93.3% of red zone opportunities. NC State is 22nd in the FBS with an average time of possession of 32:58. Team leaders Louisville Passing: Lincoln Kienholz, 1,140 yards, 7 TDs, 1 INT, 68.8 completion percentage Rushing: Keyjuan Brown, 279 yards on 30 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Tre Richardson, 328 yards on 20 catches, 1 TD NC State Passing: C.J. Bailey, 893 yards, 6 TDs, 3 INTs, 67.3 completion percentage Rushing: Jayden Scott, 346 yards on 57 carries, 4 TDs Receiving: Keenan Jackson, 295 yards on 19 catches, 4 TDs Last game Louisville fell to Wake Forest 30-27 on Sept. 26. Kienholz led Louisville with 324 yards on 27-of-36 passing (75.0%) for one touchdown and one interception. He also carried the ball 13 times for -19 yards and two rushing touchdowns. Brown had 48 rushing yards on 12 carries. Richardson recorded 85 yards on five catches. NC State won 41-31 over Appalachian State on Sept. 26. Bailey threw for 253 yards on 24-of-33 attempts (72.7%) with two touchdowns and one interception. He also carried the ball two times for 6 yards and one rushing touchdown. Scott carried the ball 25 times for 148 yards and scored two touchdowns, adding two receptions for eight yards. Jackson recorded 64 yards on four catches with one touchdown. Next game Louisville hosts Florida State on Oct. 9. NC State hosts Wake Forest on Oct. 10.
